name: Roundshaw Downs Rosehips & Sloes
short_description: Hedgerow fruits on old airfield open space.
description: The scrubby hedgerows and thickets of Roundshaw Downs local nature reserve on the old Croydon Airport site have outstanding rosehip and sloe crops in autumn.
